attachments.title: Attachments
attachments.openMessageTip: Opens here, in a new level of this tab

body.label: Message content · shown in isolation, scripts off

remote.title: Remote images and styles are blocked.
remote.why: Loading them lets the sender see that you opened this message.
remote.loaded: Remote content is loaded for this message. Other messages still block it.

signature.help: This message has a digital signature, but EmailFileViewer doesn't check signatures. It can't confirm who sent the message or that it wasn't changed.

encrypted.title: This message is encrypted
encrypted.body: EmailFileViewer can't decrypt S/MIME messages, so the content can't be shown. The details above were sent unencrypted. To read it, open the file in a mail app that has the recipient's certificate.

empty.title: Open an email file
empty.body: Drop .eml or .msg files anywhere in this window, or choose them from your computer.
empty.privacy: Messages are read on this computer. Nothing is uploaded unless you choose to.

drop.body: Each file opens in its own tab. Text and links are ignored.

unsupported.title: This file isn't a supported email
unsupported.body: EmailFileViewer opens .eml and .msg files. This file's contents don't match either format, whatever its extension says.

corrupt.title: This file is damaged
corrupt.body: Parts of the file are missing or malformed, so the message can't be read. If someone sent it to you, ask them for a new copy.

unreadable.title: This file can't be read
unreadable.body: It may have been moved or deleted, or you may not have permission to open it.

generic.title: This file couldn't be opened
generic.body: An unexpected error stopped EmailFileViewer from opening this file. Close this tab and try again; if it keeps happening, the file may be damaged.

executable.title: “{{name}}” can't be opened here
executable.body: Programs and scripts can change things on your computer, so EmailFileViewer won't open them. You can save the file and decide what to do with it yourself.
executable.extra: Run it only if you trust the sender and were expecting this file.

settings.title: Settings
settings.languageHint: Changes apply right away. Email content is never translated.
settings.appearanceHint: Applies to the app only. Messages always appear on a light page, the way the sender designed them.

reason.write_failed: It couldn't be written there. Check that the folder exists, that you have permission to write to it, and that the disk isn't full.
reason.document_not_found: This message is no longer open. Close the tab and open the file again.
reason.attachment_not_found: This attachment isn't in the message any more.
reason.unsupported_format: This attachment isn't a valid email.
reason.corrupted: The attachment is damaged or can't be read.
reason.dialog_failed: The system dialog could not be shown.
reason.timeout: The operation timed out. The file may still be saving, so check the destination.
reason.openTimeout: Opening the attachment timed out. Try again.
